text.p: Nestle SA said that its sales for the first 10 months of 1996 grew 5.7 percent versus the comparable 1995 period.
Sales were reported at 48.3 billion Swiss francs.
In the comparable 1995 period, sales were 45.7 billion Swiss francs.

In a press release accompanying its 10-month results, Nestle said that sales volume growth measured for the period to end-October was 3.0 percent, a slight slowing from 3.6 percent growth reported for the first half.

"This slight slowdown of growth is largely due to bad weather conditions in Europe in August and September, which naturally had a negative impact on sales of mineral water and ice cream," Nestle said.
"On the other hand, encouraging growth continued in soluble coffee," it said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
